items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: I played with Chris Kelly. Played banjo. Who else was in Chris Kelly's band?

ctx.x: Fred Washington? Good. Yeah. I know him pretty good.

Yeah. Now you want to know the fellas that I played with? Yeah. Well, I played with Chris Kelly. Played banjo. Who else was in Chris Kelly's band? Who else was in Chris Kelly's band? Who else was in Chris Kelly's band? Well, I don't know the boys. How many pieces do you have? We had five pieces. Five pieces. Five pieces. No, I played with…
That was real interesting what you were saying about Gayno.

items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: And Chris Kelly, Kid Rainey, Frankie Duesen, a lot of those guys, you know what I mean?

ctx.x: Can you remember about the earliest music you ever heard? Was there any music around your home that your folks played?

Oh yeah, no of my folks never played but there's a lot of fellas like Paul Dominguez. Was he playing violin? Violin, he was playing in them days. And Piron, he was playing in those days. And I just can't call a lot of those guys names, you know what I mean? I forgot a lot of them. Oh sure. And Chris Kelly, Kid Rainey, Frankie Duesen, a lot of those guys, you know what I mean? And oh there's so many of them. And Freddie Washington, well I'm- Oh the piano player. He was the piano player, you know him.
He's very sick now in California. Yeah, yeah. And I saw him last year.
